scope: Closed B3c1 member snapshots 2.0 on disposable Hub WordPress/MariaDB; synthetic data; no site or public score
checks: B3s normal bootstrap and B3 ranked installation do not install member snapshots
B3s explicit installation requires the complete H4 snapshot dependency
B3s partial metadata is refused without adopting historical or new tables
B3s isolated explicit installation atomically publishes four verified InnoDB tables
B3s empty member snapshot attests one empty page and an owner ordering epoch
B3s six concurrent same-key requests materialize one immutable generation
B3s pagination beyond one hundred rows includes every ranked allocation once
B3s every fact carries the same original context and a unique owner order
B3s cursor and generation are bound to member and exact authorized client
B3s final primary fence attests the exact full current generation
B3s duplicated cross-page order and missing rows cannot become a complete snapshot
B3s materialization and primary fence reject a pending H4 correction fragment
B3s frozen pages remain unchanged during correction and same-key replay
B3s newer cumulative correction supersedes the fence but never rewrites old pages
B3s corrected net and original order context and timestamp remain distinct authorities
B3s new consumption after materialization invalidates the old complete fence
B3s effective closure preserves already confirmed facts and their complete snapshot
B3s multiple lot allocations retain one consumption and one immutable ranking authority
B3s H4 partially_cancelled revision 2 preserves the original ranking fact with latest net
B3s H4 disputed revision 3 preserves the original ranking fact with latest net
B3s H4 partially_cancelled revision 4 preserves the original ranking fact with latest net
B3s H4 cancelled revision 5 preserves the original ranking fact with latest net
B3s old consumption is explicitly unranked without retroactive category or order
B3s b3s-snapshot-insert rolls back materialized pages key and generation together
B3s exact retry after b3s-snapshot-insert produces one complete recoverable snapshot
B3s b3s-page-insert rolls back materialized pages key and generation together
B3s exact retry after b3s-page-insert produces one complete recoverable snapshot
B3s primary resolves before-commit materialization outcome before stable recovery
B3s same-key before-commit recovery preserves one generation and exact page
B3s primary resolves after-commit materialization outcome before stable recovery
B3s same-key after-commit recovery preserves one generation and exact page
B3s lost COMMIT acknowledgement is unknown and never a false rollback
B3s primary resolves commit-unknown materialization outcome before stable recovery
B3s same-key commit-unknown recovery preserves one generation and exact page
B3s missing materialized page cannot be silently replaced from current rows
B3s altered stored page digest refuses private delivery
B3s restored foreign generation epoch refuses materialization and final attestation
B3s restored generation counter cannot reuse a previously assigned revision
B3s a restored contradictory owner epoch cannot attest a current snapshot
B3s nontransactional page schema refuses reads and installs without repair
B3s all previous official PF and ALB rows and H3 receipts remain byte identical
